+  Future<void> _loadFavorite() async {
+    if (!context.read<RidiStore>().loggedIn) {
+      setState(() => _favoriteLoading = false);
+      return;
+    }
+    try {
+      final repository = BookRepository(
+        ApiClient(tokenProvider: () => context.read<RidiStore>().accessToken),
+      );
+      final favorite = await repository.favoriteStatus(widget.bookId);
+      if (mounted) setState(() => _favorite = favorite);
+    } catch (_) {
+      if (mounted) {
+        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
+          const SnackBar(content: Text('즐겨찾기 상태를 불러오지 못했습니다.')),
+        );
+      }
+    } finally {
+      if (mounted) setState(() => _favoriteLoading = false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  Future<void> _toggleFavorite() async {
+    if (_favoriteLoading || _favoriteSaving) return;
+    if (!context.read<RidiStore>().loggedIn) {
+      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
+        const SnackBar(content: Text('로그인이 필요합니다.')),
+      );
+      return;
+    }
+    final before = _favorite;
+    setState(() {
+      _favorite = !before;
+      _favoriteSaving = true;
+    });
+    try {
+      await context.read<FavoriteViewModel>().setFavorite(widget.bookId, !before);
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (mounted) {
+        setState(() => _favorite = before);
+        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
+          SnackBar(content: Text(error is ApiException
+              ? error.message
+              : '즐겨찾기를 변경하지 못했습니다. 다시 시도해 주세요.')),
+        );
+      }
+    } finally {
+      if (mounted) setState(() => _favoriteSaving = false);
+    }
+  }

   Future<List<ReadingRoom>> _loadRooms(int revision) async {
     final rooms = await _repository.myRooms();
+    final covers = <int, String?>{};
+    final bookIds = <int, int>{};
+    final ownerNames = <int, String>{};
+    await Future.wait(rooms.map((room) async {
+      try {
+        final detail = room.books.isEmpty || room.ownerNickname == '알 수 없음'
+            ? await _repository.detail(room.id) : room;
+        final owner = detail.participants.where((member) =>
+        member.userId == detail.ownerId ||
+            member.role.toUpperCase() == 'OWNER' ||
+            member.role.toUpperCase() == 'HOST').firstOrNull;
+        final name = owner?.nickname.trim();
+        ownerNames[room.id] = name != null && name.isNotEmpty && name != '알 수 없음'
+            ? name : detail.ownerNickname;
+        final fallbackId = detail.coverBook?.id ?? detail.book?.id ??
+            detail.bookId ?? detail.books.firstOrNull?.book.id;
+        if (fallbackId != null) bookIds[room.id] = fallbackId;
+        DateTime? latest;
+        for (final result in await Future.wait(detail.books.map((item) async {
+          final records = await _repository.participantProgress(room.id, item.book.id);
+          final mine = records.where((record) => record.currentUser).firstOrNull;
+          return (item.book.coverImageUrl, mine?.updatedAt, item.book.id);
+        }))) {
+          final time = result.$2;
+          if (time != null && (latest == null || time.isAfter(latest))) {
+            latest = time;
+            covers[room.id] = result.$1;
+            bookIds[room.id] = result.$3;
+          }
+        }
+      } catch (_) {
+        // Keep the existing room cover if reading history is unavailable.
+      }
+    }));
     if (mounted && revision == _roomRevision) {
       _roomCache = List.unmodifiable(rooms);
+      _myRecentCovers = covers;
+      _coverBookIds = bookIds;
+      _roomOwnerNames = ownerNames;
     }
     return rooms;
   }

+class _JoinRoomProfileScreen extends StatefulWidget {
+  const _JoinRoomProfileScreen({required this.repository, required this.room});
+  final ReadingRoomRepository repository;
+  final ReadingRoom room;
+  @override
+  State<_JoinRoomProfileScreen> createState() => _JoinRoomProfileScreenState();
+}
+
+class _JoinRoomProfileScreenState extends State<_JoinRoomProfileScreen> {
+  late final TextEditingController _name;
+  Uint8List? _photo;
+  String? _photoName;
+  bool _saving = false;
+  String? _error;
+
+  @override
+  void initState() {
+    super.initState();
+    _name = TextEditingController(text:
+    widget.room.participants.where((m) => m.currentUser).firstOrNull?.nickname
+        ?? context.read<RidiStore>().nickname);
+  }
+
+  @override
+  void dispose() { _name.dispose(); super.dispose(); }
+
+  Future<void> _pickPhoto() async {
+    final file = await ImagePicker().pickImage(source: ImageSource.gallery,
+        maxWidth: 1200, maxHeight: 1200, imageQuality: 85);
+    if (file == null) return;
+    final bytes = await file.readAsBytes();
+    if (mounted) setState(() { _photo = bytes; _photoName = file.name; });
+  }
+
+  Future<void> _save() async {
+    if (_saving) return;
+    final name = _name.text.trim();
+    if (name.isEmpty) { setState(() => _error = '이름을 입력해주세요.'); return; }
+    setState(() { _saving = true; _error = null; });
+    try {
+      var room = await widget.repository.updateMyRoomNickname(widget.room.id, name);
+      if (_photo != null) {
+        room = await widget.repository.uploadMyRoomProfileImage(
+            widget.room.id, bytes: _photo!, filename: _photoName ?? 'profile.jpg',
+            contentType: (_photoName ?? '').toLowerCase().endsWith('.png')
+                ? 'image/png' : 'image/jpeg');
+      }
+      if (mounted) Navigator.of(context).pop(room);
+    } catch (_) {
+      if (mounted) setState(() => _error = '프로필을 저장하지 못했습니다. 다시 시도해주세요.');
+    } finally {
+      if (mounted) setState(() => _saving = false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
+    appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('방 프로필 설정')),
+    bottomNavigationBar: SafeArea(child: Padding(
+      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
+      child: FilledButton(onPressed: _saving ? null : _save,
+          child: Text(_saving ? '저장 중…' : '완료하고 방 입장')),
+    )),
+    body: ListView(padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24), children: [
+      Text(widget.room.name, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge),
+      const SizedBox(height: 12),
+      const Text('이 방에서 사용할 사진과 이름을 설정해주세요.'),
+      const SizedBox(height: 28),
+      Center(child: InkWell(onTap: _saving ? null : _pickPhoto,
+        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(60),
+        child: CircleAvatar(radius: 56,
+            backgroundImage: _photo == null ? null : MemoryImage(_photo!),
+            child: _photo == null ? const Icon(Icons.add_a_photo_outlined, size: 32) : null),
+      )),
+      const SizedBox(height: 24),
+      TextField(controller: _name, enabled: !_saving, maxLength: 40,
+          decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: '이 방에서 사용할 이름')),
+      if (_error != null) Text(_error!, style: TextStyle(color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error)),
+    ]),
+  );
+}

+package com.aicamp.changebook;

+import jakarta.persistence.*;
+
+@Entity
+@Table(
+    name = "change_book_ai_friend_highlight_colors",

+class AiFriendHighlightColor {

+

+}

+interface AiFriendHighlightColorRepository
+    extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<
+        AiFriendHighlightColor, Long> {
+
+    java.util.Optional<AiFriendHighlightColor>
+        findByUserIdAndFriendId(Long userId, Long friendId);

+package com.aicamp.changebook;
+
+import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
+import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
+import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
+import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
+
+import java.util.Set;
+
+@RestController
+@RequestMapping("/api/ai-reading-friends/{friendId}/highlight-color")
+class AiFriendHighlightColorController {
+
+    private final AiFriendHighlightColorRepository colorRepository;
+    private final AiReadingFriendRepository friendRepository;
+    private final UserRepository userRepository;
+
+    AiFriendHighlightColorController(
+            AiFriendHighlightColorRepository colorRepository,
+            AiReadingFriendRepository friendRepository,
+            UserRepository userRepository
+    ) {
+        this.colorRepository = colorRepository;
+        this.friendRepository = friendRepository;
+        this.userRepository = userRepository;
+    }
+
+    private Long getUserId(Authentication authentication) {
+        if (authentication == null || !authentication.isAuthenticated()) {
+            throw new ApiException(
+                    HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,
+                    "UNAUTHORIZED",
+                    "로그인이 필요합니다."
+            );
+        }
+
+        return userRepository.findByUsername(authentication.getName())
+                .orElseThrow(() -> new ApiException(
+                        HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED,
+                        "UNAUTHORIZED",
+                        "로그인이 필요합니다."
+                )).id;
+    }
+
+    private void checkFriend(Long friendId, Long userId) {
+        AiReadingFriend friend = friendRepository.findById(friendId)
+                .orElseThrow(() -> new ApiException(
+                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
+                        "AI_FRIEND_NOT_FOUND",
+                        "AI 친구를 찾을 수 없습니다."
+                ));
+
+        if (!friend.isDefault && !userId.equals(friend.userId)) {
+            throw new ApiException(
+                    HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
+                    "AI_FRIEND_NOT_FOUND",
+                    "AI 친구를 찾을 수 없습니다."
+            );
+        }
+    }
+
+    record ColorResponse(String highlightColor) {}
+
+    record ColorRequest(String highlightColor) {}
+
+    @GetMapping
+    ColorResponse getColor(
+            @PathVariable Long friendId,
+            Authentication authentication
+    ) {
+        Long userId = getUserId(authentication);
+        checkFriend(friendId, userId);
+
+        String color = colorRepository
+                .findByUserIdAndFriendId(userId, friendId)
+                .map(item -> item.highlightColor)
+                .orElse("YELLOW");
+
+        return new ColorResponse(color);
+    }
+
+    @PutMapping
+    @Transactional
+    ColorResponse saveColor(
+            @PathVariable Long friendId,
+            @RequestBody ColorRequest request,
+            Authentication authentication
+    ) {
+        Long userId = getUserId(authentication);
+        checkFriend(friendId, userId);
+
+        Set<String> allowedColors = Set.of(
+                "YELLOW", "PINK", "GREEN",
+                "BLUE", "PURPLE", "ORANGE"
+        );
+
+        if (request == null ||
+                request.highlightColor() == null ||
+                !allowedColors.contains(request.highlightColor())) {
+            throw new ApiException(
+                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
+                    "INVALID_HIGHLIGHT_COLOR",
+                    "지원하지 않는 형광펜 색상입니다."
+            );
+        }
+
+        AiFriendHighlightColor setting = colorRepository
+                .findByUserIdAndFriendId(userId, friendId)
+                .orElseGet(() -> {
+                    AiFriendHighlightColor item = new AiFriendHighlightColor();
+                    item.userId = userId;
+                    item.friendId = friendId;
+                    return item;
+                });
+
+        setting.highlightColor = request.highlightColor();
+        colorRepository.save(setting);
+
+        return new ColorResponse(setting.highlightColor);
+    }
+}

+CREATE TABLE change_book_ai_friend_highlight_colors (
+    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
+    user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
+    friend_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
+    highlight_color VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'YELLOW',
+
+    CONSTRAINT fk_friend_highlight_user
+        FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
+        REFERENCES change_book_users(id)
+        ON DELETE CASCADE,
+
+    CONSTRAINT fk_friend_highlight_friend
+        FOREIGN KEY (friend_id)
+        REFERENCES change_book_ai_reading_friends(id)
+        ON DELETE CASCADE,
+
+    CONSTRAINT uq_friend_highlight_user_friend
+        UNIQUE (user_id, friend_id)
+);

+  Future<List<ReadingRoomBookItem>> _sortBooksByMyReading(ReadingRoom room) async {
+    final items = [...room.books];
+    if (!room.joined || items.length < 2) return items;
+    final lastRead = <int, DateTime?>{};
+    try {
+      await Future.wait(items.map((item) async {
+        final records = await widget.repository.participantProgress(room.id, item.book.id);
+        for (final record in records) {
+          if (record.currentUser) {
+            lastRead[item.book.id] = record.updatedAt;
+            break;
+          }
+        }
+      }));
+    } catch (_) {
+      return items;
+    }
+    final originalOrder = <int, int>{
+      for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) items[i].book.id: i,
+    };
+    items.sort((a, b) {
+      final aTime = lastRead[a.book.id];
+      final bTime = lastRead[b.book.id];
+      if (aTime != null && bTime != null) {
+        final comparison = bTime.compareTo(aTime);
+        if (comparison != 0) return comparison;
+      } else if (aTime != null) {
+        return -1;
+      } else if (bTime != null) {
+        return 1;
+      }
+      return originalOrder[a.book.id]!.compareTo(originalOrder[b.book.id]!);
+    });
+    return items;
+  }

+  List<Widget> _progressGroupMarkers(

+      double trackWidth,
+      ) {
+    final ordered = [...members]
+      ..sort((a, b) => a.currentUser == b.currentUser
+          ? a.userId.compareTo(b.userId)
+          : (a.currentUser ? -1 : 1));
+    String label(RoomParticipantProgress member) =>
+        member.currentUser ? '나' : (member.nickname.isEmpty ? '?' : member.nickname);
+    double badgeWidth(RoomParticipantProgress member) =>
+        (label(member).characters.length * 12.0 + 16).clamp(28.0, 96.0).toDouble();
+    final naturalWidth = ordered.fold<double>(0, (sum, member) => sum + badgeWidth(member))
+        + (ordered.length - 1) * 4;
+    final groupWidth = naturalWidth.clamp(0.0, trackWidth).toDouble();
+    final anchor = trackWidth * progress / 100;
+    final groupLeft = (anchor - groupWidth / 2)

+  Future<List<ReadingRoomBookItem>> _sortBooksByMyReading(ReadingRoom room) async {
+    final items = [...room.books];
+    if (!room.joined || items.length < 2) return items;
+    final lastRead = <int, DateTime?>{};
+    try {
+      await Future.wait(items.map((item) async {
+        final records = await widget.repository.participantProgress(room.id, item.book.id);
+        for (final record in records) {
+          if (record.currentUser) {
+            lastRead[item.book.id] = record.updatedAt;
+            break;
+          }
+        }
+      }));
+    } catch (_) {
+      return items;
+    }
+    final originalOrder = <int, int>{
+      for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) items[i].book.id: i,
+    };
+    items.sort((a, b) {
+      final aTime = lastRead[a.book.id];
+      final bTime = lastRead[b.book.id];
+      if (aTime != null && bTime != null) {
+        final comparison = bTime.compareTo(aTime);
+        if (comparison != 0) return comparison;
+      } else if (aTime != null) {
+        return -1;
+      } else if (bTime != null) {
+        return 1;
+      }
+      return originalOrder[a.book.id]!.compareTo(originalOrder[b.book.id]!);
+    });
+    return items;
+  }

+  List<Widget> _progressGroupMarkers(
+      int progress,
+      List<RoomParticipantProgress> members,
+      double trackWidth,
+      ) {
+    final ordered = [...members]
+      ..sort((a, b) => a.currentUser == b.currentUser
+          ? a.userId.compareTo(b.userId)
+          : (a.currentUser ? -1 : 1));
+    String label(RoomParticipantProgress member) =>
+        member.currentUser ? '나' : (member.nickname.isEmpty ? '?' : member.nickname);
+    double badgeWidth(RoomParticipantProgress member) =>
+        (label(member).characters.length * 12.0 + 16).clamp(28.0, 96.0).toDouble();
+    final naturalWidth = ordered.fold<double>(0, (sum, member) => sum + badgeWidth(member))
+        + (ordered.length - 1) * 4;
+    final groupWidth = naturalWidth.clamp(0.0, trackWidth).toDouble();
+    final anchor = trackWidth * progress / 100;
+    final groupLeft = (anchor - groupWidth / 2)
+        .clamp(0.0, trackWidth - groupWidth).toDouble();
+    final arrowColor = ordered.any((member) => member.currentUser)
+        ? const Color(0xFFE0A030)
+        : Colors.primaries[ordered.first.userId.abs() % Colors.primaries.length].shade700;
+    return [
+      Positioned(
+        left: (anchor - 8).clamp(0.0, (trackWidth - 16).clamp(0.0, trackWidth)).toDouble(),
+        top: 12,
+        child: Icon(Icons.arrow_drop_up, size: 16, color: arrowColor),
+      ),
+      Positioned(
+        left: groupLeft,

+        );

+class _SharedRoomNotesTab extends StatefulWidget {
+  const _SharedRoomNotesTab({
+    required this.roomId,
+    required this.bookId,
+    required this.type,
+    required this.onGo,
+  });
+
+  final int roomId;
+  final int bookId;
+  final String? type;
+  final ValueChanged<int> onGo;
+
+  @override
+  State<_SharedRoomNotesTab> createState() => _SharedRoomNotesTabState();
+}
+
+class _SharedRoomNotesTabState extends State<_SharedRoomNotesTab> {
+  late Future<List<SharedRoomNote>> _notes;
+  bool _roomOwner = false;
+
+  @override
+  void initState() {
+    super.initState();
+    _reload();
+    unawaited(_loadOwnerPermission());
+  }
+
+  Future<void> _loadOwnerPermission() async {
+    try {
+      final token = context.read<RidiStore>().accessToken;
+      final room = await ReadingRoomRepository(
+        ApiClient(tokenProvider: () => token),
+      ).detail(widget.roomId);
+      if (mounted) setState(() => _roomOwner = room.isOwner);
+    } on ApiException {
+      // The server remains the authority for deletion requests.
+    }
+  }
+
+  void _reload() {
+    final token = context.read<RidiStore>().accessToken;
+    _notes = ReadingRoomRepository(ApiClient(tokenProvider: () => token))
+        .sharedNotes(widget.roomId, bookId: widget.bookId);
+  }
+
+  Future<void> _reveal(SharedRoomNote note) async {
+    try {
+      final token = context.read<RidiStore>().accessToken;
+      final revealed = await ReadingRoomRepository(
+        ApiClient(tokenProvider: () => token),
+      ).revealSharedNote(widget.roomId, note.id);
+      if (mounted) {
+        setState(() {
+          _notes = _notes.then(
+                (items) => [
+              for (final item in items)
+                if (item.id == revealed.id) revealed else item,
+            ],
+          );
+        });
+      }
+    } on ApiException catch (error) {
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
+          .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(error.message)));
+    }
+  }
+
+  Future<void> _delete(SharedRoomNote note) async {
+    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
+      context: context,
+      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
+        title: const Text('공유 독서노트 삭제'),
+        content: const Text('이 독서노트를 삭제할까요?'),
+        actions: [
+          TextButton(
+            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),
+            child: const Text('취소'),
+          ),
+          FilledButton(
+            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true),
+            child: const Text('삭제'),
+          ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+    if (confirmed != true || !mounted) return;
+    try {
+      final token = context.read<RidiStore>().accessToken;
+      await ReadingRoomRepository(
+        ApiClient(tokenProvider: () => token),
+      ).deleteSharedNote(widget.roomId, note.id);
+      if (mounted) setState(_reload);
+    } on ApiException catch (error) {
+      if (mounted) {
+        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
+            .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(error.message)));
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) => FutureBuilder<List<SharedRoomNote>>(
+    future: _notes,
+    builder: (context, snapshot) {
+      if (snapshot.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
+        return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
+      }
+      if (snapshot.hasError) {
+        return Center(
+          child: TextButton(
+            onPressed: () => setState(_reload),
+            child: const Text('공유 독서노트를 불러오지 못했습니다. 다시 시도'),
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      final notes = (snapshot.data ?? const <SharedRoomNote>[])
+          .where((note) => widget.type == null || note.type == widget.type)
+          .toList();
+      if (notes.isEmpty) return const Center(child: Text('공유 독서노트가 없습니다.'));
+      return RefreshIndicator(
+        onRefresh: () async => setState(_reload),
+        child: ListView.separated(
+          physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
+          itemCount: notes.length,
+          separatorBuilder: (_, _) => const Divider(height: 1),
+          itemBuilder: (_, index) {
+            final note = notes[index];
+            final label = switch (note.type) {
+              'HIGHLIGHT' => '하이라이트',
+              'BOOKMARK' => '북마크',
+              _ => '메모',
+            };
+            if (note.isSpoilerLocked) {
+              return ListTile(
+                leading: const Icon(Icons.lock_outline),
+                title: Text('$label · 스포일러 잠금'),
+                subtitle: Text('${note.nickname} · 문단 ${note.paragraphOrder}'),
+                trailing: TextButton(
+                  onPressed: () => _reveal(note),
+                  child: const Text('내용 보기'),
+                ),
+              );
+            }
+            final text = note.content?.isNotEmpty == true
+                ? note.content!
+                : note.selectedText?.isNotEmpty == true
+                ? note.selectedText!
+                : label;
+            return ListTile(
+              leading: Icon(
+                note.type == 'HIGHLIGHT'
+                    ? Icons.format_paint_outlined
+                    : note.type == 'BOOKMARK'
+                    ? Icons.bookmark_outline
+                    : Icons.sticky_note_2_outlined,
+              ),
+              title: Text(text, maxLines: 2, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
+              subtitle: Text(
+                '${note.nickname} · $label · 문단 ${note.paragraphOrder}',
+              ),
+              onTap: () => widget.onGo(note.paragraphOrder),
+              trailing: note.mine || _roomOwner
+                  ? IconButton(
+                tooltip: '독서노트 삭제',
+                icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline),
+                onPressed: () => _delete(note),
+              )
+                  : null,
+            );
+          },
+        ),
+      );
+    },
+  );
+}

+  /// Remove a book from the active room immediately.  The room keeps at least
+  /// one book so its current-reading target always remains valid.
+  bool removeRoomBook(String roomId, String bookId) {
+    final r = room(roomId);
+    if (r == null || r.bookIds.length <= 1 || !r.bookIds.contains(bookId)) {

+    }
+    r.bookIds = r.bookIds.where((id) => id != bookId).toList();

+  }

+import 'package:flutter_app/view/ridi/ridi_store.dart';

+import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
+  SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({});
+
+  test('room book removal updates the room and its current-book target', () {
+    final store = RidiStore();
+    final room = store.room('r2')!;
+    room.members = [RidiMember(store.name, owner: true)];
+
+    expect(store.removeRoomBook(room.id, 'b1'), isTrue);
+    expect(room.bookIds, isNot(contains('b1')));
+    expect(room.lastBookId, room.bookIds.first);
+    expect(store.removeRoomBook(room.id, 'missing'), isFalse);
+  });
+
+  test('room owner can remove a shared note and its comments', () {
+    final store = RidiStore();
+    final room = store.room('r2')!;
+    room.members = [RidiMember(store.name, owner: true)];
+    final note = RidiNote(
+      id: 'shared-note',
+      bookId: 'b1',
+      kind: NoteKind.highlight,
+      chapter: 0,
+      page: 1,
+      line: 0,
+      phrase: 'shared',
+      createdAt: DateTime(2026, 10, 12),
+      roomIds: [room.id],
+      mine: false,
+      author: 'member',
+    );
+    store.notes.add(note);
+    store.comments.add(
+      RidiComment(
+        id: 'shared-comment',
+        noteId: note.id,
+        text: 'comment',
+        createdAt: DateTime(2026, 10, 12),
+      ),
+    );
+
+    expect(store.canDeleteNote(note), isTrue);
+    store.deleteNotes([note.id]);
+
+    expect(store.note(note.id), isNull);
+    expect(store.commentsOf(note.id), isEmpty);
+  });

+package com.aicamp.changebook;
+
+import jakarta.persistence.*;
+import jakarta.validation.Valid;
+import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;
+import java.time.Instant;
+import java.util.List;
+import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
+import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
+import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
+import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
+import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
+
+/** Links existing source notes to rooms; no note content is copied. */
+@Entity
+@Table(name = "change_book_memo_shares")
+class MemoShare {
+  @Id @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY) Long id;
+  @Column(name = "personal_memo_id") Long personalMemoId;
+  @Column(name = "room_memo_id") Long roomMemoId;
+  @Column(name = "target_room_id", nullable = false) Long targetRoomId;
+  @Column(name = "shared_by", nullable = false) Long sharedBy;
+  @Column(name = "shared_at", nullable = false, insertable = false, updatable = false) Instant sharedAt;
+}
+
+interface MemoShareRepository extends JpaRepository<MemoShare, Long> {
+  List<MemoShare> findByTargetRoomIdOrderByIdDesc(Long roomId);
+  boolean existsByTargetRoomIdAndPersonalMemoId(Long roomId, Long memoId);
+  boolean existsByTargetRoomIdAndRoomMemoId(Long roomId, Long memoId);
+}
+
+record MemoFeedItem(String source, RoomNoteResponse roomNote, MemoShareResponse sharedMemo) {}
+
+record MemoShareRequest(@NotNull String sourceType, @NotNull Long memoId) {}
+record MemoShareResponse(Long shareId, String sourceType, Long memoId, Long bookId,
+    Long authorId, String type, int paragraphOrder, Integer startOffset, Integer endOffset,
+    String selectedText, String content, String highlightColor, boolean spoilerLocked,
+    boolean mine, Instant sharedAt) {}
+
+@Service
+class MemoShareService {
+  private final MemoShareRepository shares;
+  private final ReadingNoteRepository personal;
+  private final ReadingRoomNoteRepository roomNotes;
+  private final RoomRepo rooms;
+  private final RoomMemberRepo members;
+  private final RoomBookRepo roomBooks;
+  private final UserFeatureService users;
+  private final RoomMemberProgressRepo progress;
+
+  MemoShareService(MemoShareRepository shares, ReadingNoteRepository personal,
+      ReadingRoomNoteRepository roomNotes, RoomRepo rooms, RoomMemberRepo members,
+      RoomBookRepo roomBooks, UserFeatureService users, RoomMemberProgressRepo progress) {
+    this.shares = shares; this.personal = personal; this.roomNotes = roomNotes;
+    this.rooms = rooms; this.members = members; this.roomBooks = roomBooks;
+    this.users = users; this.progress = progress;
+  }
+
+  private AppUser member(String username, Long roomId) {
+    AppUser user = users.me(username);
+    if (!rooms.existsById(roomId))
+      throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "ROOM_NOT_FOUND", "독서방이 없습니다.");
+    if (!members.existsByRoomIdAndUserId(roomId, user.id))
+      throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "ROOM_MEMBER_REQUIRED", "독서방 참여자만 사용할 수 있습니다.");
+    return user;
+  }
+
+  @Transactional
+  MemoShareResponse share(String username, Long targetRoomId, MemoShareRequest request) {
+    AppUser user = member(username, targetRoomId);
+    if (request.memoId() == null || request.memoId() <= 0)
+      throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "INVALID_MEMO_ID", "메모 ID를 확인해 주세요.");
+    MemoShare share = new MemoShare();
+    share.targetRoomId = targetRoomId;
+    share.sharedBy = user.id;
+    Long bookId;
+    if ("PERSONAL".equals(request.sourceType())) {
+      ReadingNote note = personal.findById(request.memoId())
+          .orElseThrow(() -> new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "MEMO_NOT_FOUND", "메모가 없습니다."));
+      if (!note.user.id.equals(user.id))
+        throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "MEMO_OWNER_REQUIRED", "본인 메모만 공유할 수 있습니다.");
+      if (note.noteType != ReadingNoteType.MEMO)
+        throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "MEMO_ONLY", "메모만 공유할 수 있습니다.");
+      if (shares.existsByTargetRoomIdAndPersonalMemoId(targetRoomId, note.id))
+        throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "ALREADY_SHARED", "이미 공유한 메모입니다.");
+      bookId = note.bookId;
+      share.personalMemoId = note.id;
+    } else if ("ROOM".equals(request.sourceType())) {
+      ReadingRoomNote note = roomNotes.findById(request.memoId())
+          .orElseThrow(() -> new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "MEMO_NOT_FOUND", "메모가 없습니다."));
+      if (!note.userId.equals(user.id))
+        throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "MEMO_OWNER_REQUIRED", "본인 메모만 공유할 수 있습니다.");
+      if (!"MEMO".equals(note.type))
+        throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "MEMO_ONLY", "메모만 공유할 수 있습니다.");
+      if (!members.existsByRoomIdAndUserId(note.roomId, user.id))
+        throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "SOURCE_ROOM_MEMBER_REQUIRED", "원본 독서방 참여자여야 합니다.");
+      if (note.roomId.equals(targetRoomId))
+        throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "SAME_ROOM", "이미 원본 메모가 있는 방입니다.");
+      if (shares.existsByTargetRoomIdAndRoomMemoId(targetRoomId, note.id))
+        throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "ALREADY_SHARED", "이미 공유한 메모입니다.");
+      bookId = note.bookId;
+      share.roomMemoId = note.id;
+    } else {
+      throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "INVALID_SOURCE_TYPE", "PERSONAL 또는 ROOM을 선택해 주세요.");
+    }
+    if (!roomBooks.existsByRoomIdAndBookId(targetRoomId, bookId))
+      throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "ROOM_BOOK_MISMATCH", "대상 독서방에 등록된 책이 아닙니다.");
+    shares.saveAndFlush(share);
+    return response(user, targetRoomId, share);
+  }
+
+  @Transactional(readOnly = true)
+  List<MemoShareResponse> list(String username, Long roomId, Long bookId) {
+    AppUser user = member(username, roomId);
+    return shares.findByTargetRoomIdOrderByIdDesc(roomId).stream()
+        .map(share -> response(user, roomId, share))
+        .filter(r -> bookId == null || bookId.equals(r.bookId()))
+        .toList();
+  }
+
+  @Transactional
+  void revoke(String username, Long roomId, Long shareId) {
+    AppUser user = member(username, roomId);
+    MemoShare share = shares.findById(shareId)
+        .filter(s -> s.targetRoomId.equals(roomId))
+        .orElseThrow(() -> new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "SHARE_NOT_FOUND", "공유 기록이 없습니다."));
+    if (!share.sharedBy.equals(user.id))
+      throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "SHARE_OWNER_REQUIRED", "공유한 사람만 취소할 수 있습니다.");
+    shares.delete(share);
+  }
+
+  private MemoShareResponse response(AppUser viewer, Long roomId, MemoShare share) {
+    Long memoId, bookId, authorId;
+    String type, selected, content, color;
+    int paragraphOrder;
+    Integer start, end;
+    if (share.personalMemoId != null) {
+      ReadingNote n = personal.findById(share.personalMemoId).orElseThrow();
+      memoId = n.id; bookId = n.bookId; authorId = n.user.id;
+      type = n.noteType.name(); paragraphOrder = n.paragraphOrder;
+      start = n.startOffset; end = n.endOffset; selected = n.selectedText;
+      content = n.memoContent; color = n.highlightColor;
+    } else {
+      ReadingRoomNote n = roomNotes.findById(share.roomMemoId).orElseThrow();
+      memoId = n.id; bookId = n.bookId; authorId = n.userId;
+      type = n.type; paragraphOrder = n.paragraphOrder;
+      start = n.startOffset; end = n.endOffset; selected = n.selectedText;
+      content = n.content; color = n.highlightColor;
+    }
+    boolean lockEnabled = members.findByRoomIdAndUserId(roomId, viewer.id)
+        .map(m -> m.spoilerLockEnabled).orElse(false);
+    int lastPosition = progress.findByRoomIdAndUserIdAndBookId(roomId, viewer.id, bookId)
+        .map(p -> p.lastReadPosition).orElse(0);
+    boolean locked = lockEnabled && !viewer.id.equals(authorId) && paragraphOrder > lastPosition;
+    return new MemoShareResponse(share.id, share.personalMemoId != null ? "PERSONAL" : "ROOM",
+        memoId, bookId, authorId, type, paragraphOrder,
+        locked ? null : start, locked ? null : end,
+        locked ? null : selected, locked ? null : content, locked ? null : color,
+        locked, viewer.id.equals(authorId), share.sharedAt);
+  }
+}
+
+@RestController
+@RequestMapping("/api/reading-rooms/{roomId}/memo-shares")
+class MemoShareController {
+  private final MemoShareService service;
+  private final ReadingRoomNoteService roomNoteService;
+  MemoShareController(MemoShareService service, ReadingRoomNoteService roomNoteService) {
+    this.service = service; this.roomNoteService = roomNoteService;
+  }
+
+  /** Combined read-only feed. Original note APIs and comment IDs remain untouched. */
+  @GetMapping("/feed")
+  List<MemoFeedItem> feed(@PathVariable Long roomId, @RequestParam(required = false) Long bookId,
+      org.springframework.security.core.Authentication auth) {
+    List<MemoFeedItem> result = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
+    for (RoomNoteResponse note : roomNoteService.list(auth.getName(), roomId, bookId))
+      result.add(new MemoFeedItem("ROOM", note, null));
+    for (MemoShareResponse share : service.list(auth.getName(), roomId, bookId))
+      result.add(new MemoFeedItem("SHARED", null, share));
+    result.sort(java.util.Comparator.comparingInt(item ->
+        item.roomNote() != null ? item.roomNote().paragraphOrder() : item.sharedMemo().paragraphOrder()));
+    return result;
+  }
+
+  @PostMapping
+  @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
+  MemoShareResponse share(@PathVariable Long roomId, @Valid @RequestBody MemoShareRequest request,
+      org.springframework.security.core.Authentication auth) {
+    return service.share(auth.getName(), roomId, request);
+  }
+
+  @GetMapping
+  List<MemoShareResponse> list(@PathVariable Long roomId, @RequestParam(required = false) Long bookId,
+      org.springframework.security.core.Authentication auth) {
+    return service.list(auth.getName(), roomId, bookId);
+  }
+
+  @DeleteMapping("/{shareId}")
+  @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
+  void revoke(@PathVariable Long roomId, @PathVariable Long shareId,
+      org.springframework.security.core.Authentication auth) {
+    service.revoke(auth.getName(), roomId, shareId);
+  }
+}

+import '../core/api_client.dart';
+
+/// 메모 원본의 위치
+/// PERSONAL: 혼자읽기 메모
+/// ROOM: 교환독서방 메모
+enum MemoShareSource {
+  personal,
+  room,
+}
+
+/// 공유된 메모 정보
+class MemoShareRecord {
+  const MemoShareRecord({
+    required this.shareId,
+    required this.sourceType,
+    required this.memoId,
+    required this.bookId,
+    required this.authorId,
+    required this.content,
+    required this.spoilerLocked,
+    required this.mine,
+  });
+
+  final int shareId;
+  final String sourceType;
+  final int memoId;
+  final int bookId;
+  final int authorId;
+  final String? content;
+  final bool spoilerLocked;
+  final bool mine;
+
+  factory MemoShareRecord.fromJson(
+      Map<String, dynamic> json,
+      ) {
+    return MemoShareRecord(
+      shareId: (json['shareId'] as num).toInt(),
+      sourceType: json['sourceType'] as String,
+      memoId: (json['memoId'] as num).toInt(),
+      bookId: (json['bookId'] as num).toInt(),
+      authorId: (json['authorId'] as num).toInt(),
+      content: json['content'] as String?,
+      spoilerLocked: json['spoilerLocked'] == true,
+      mine: json['mine'] == true,
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+/// 메모 공유 API
+class MemoShareRepository {
+  const MemoShareRepository(this._api);
+
+  final ApiClient _api;
+
+  /// 선택한 메모를 대상 독서방에 공유
+  Future<MemoShareRecord> share({
+    required int targetRoomId,
+    required MemoShareSource source,
+    required int memoId,
+  }) async {
+    final response = await _api.post<MemoShareRecord>(
+      '/api/reading-rooms/$targetRoomId/memo-shares',
+      body: {
+        'sourceType':
+        source == MemoShareSource.personal
+            ? 'PERSONAL'
+            : 'ROOM',
+        'memoId': memoId,
+      },
+      parse: (json) => MemoShareRecord.fromJson(
+        json as Map<String, dynamic>,
+      ),
+    );
+
+    return response.data!;
+  }
+
+  /// 해당 독서방에 공유된 메모 목록
+  Future<List<MemoShareRecord>> list({
+    required int roomId,
+    int? bookId,
+  }) async {
+    final response =
+    await _api.get<List<MemoShareRecord>>(
+      '/api/reading-rooms/$roomId/memo-shares',
+      query: {
+        if (bookId != null) 'bookId': '$bookId',
+      },
+      parse: (json) => (json as List<dynamic>)
+          .map(
+            (e) => MemoShareRecord.fromJson(
+          e as Map<String, dynamic>,
+        ),
+      )
+          .toList(),
+    );
+
+    return response.data ?? const [];
+  }
+
+  /// 특정 독서방에서만 공유 취소
+  /// 원본 메모는 삭제하지 않음
+  Future<void> revoke({
+    required int roomId,
+    required int shareId,
+  }) async {
+    await _api.delete<void>(
+      '/api/reading-rooms/$roomId/memo-shares/$shareId',
+    );
+  }
+
+  /// 기존 독서방 메모 + 공유받은 메모 통합 조회
+  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> feed({
+    required int roomId,
+    required int bookId,
+  }) async {
+    final response =
+    await _api.get<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
+      '/api/reading-rooms/$roomId/memo-shares/feed',
+      query: {
+        'bookId': '$bookId',
+      },
+      parse: (json) => (json as List<dynamic>)
+          .map(
+            (e) => e as Map<String, dynamic>,
+      )
+          .toList(),
+    );
+
+    return response.data ?? const [];
+  }
+}

+package com.aicamp.changebook;
+
+import jakarta.persistence.*;
+import jakarta.validation.Valid;
+import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;
+import java.time.Instant;
+import java.util.List;
+import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
+import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
+import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
+import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
+import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
+
+/** Links existing source notes to rooms; no note content is copied. */
+@Entity
+@Table(name = "change_book_memo_shares")
+class MemoShare {
+  @Id @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY) Long id;
+  @Column(name = "personal_memo_id") Long personalMemoId;
+  @Column(name = "room_memo_id") Long roomMemoId;
+  @Column(name = "target_room_id", nullable = false) Long targetRoomId;
+  @Column(name = "shared_by", nullable = false) Long sharedBy;
+  @Column(name = "shared_at", nullable = false, insertable = false, updatable = false) Instant sharedAt;
+}
+
+interface MemoShareRepository extends JpaRepository<MemoShare, Long> {
+  List<MemoShare> findByTargetRoomIdOrderByIdDesc(Long roomId);
+  boolean existsByTargetRoomIdAndPersonalMemoId(Long roomId, Long memoId);
+  boolean existsByTargetRoomIdAndRoomMemoId(Long roomId, Long memoId);
+}
+
+record MemoFeedItem(String source, RoomNoteResponse roomNote, MemoShareResponse sharedMemo) {}
+
+record MemoShareRequest(@NotNull String sourceType, @NotNull Long memoId) {}
+record MemoShareResponse(Long shareId, String sourceType, Long memoId, Long bookId,
+    Long authorId, String type, int paragraphOrder, Integer startOffset, Integer endOffset,
+    String selectedText, String content, String highlightColor, boolean spoilerLocked,
+    boolean mine, Instant sharedAt) {}
+
+@Service
+class MemoShareService {
+  private final MemoShareRepository shares;
+  private final ReadingNoteRepository personal;
+  private final ReadingRoomNoteRepository roomNotes;
+  private final RoomRepo rooms;
+  private final RoomMemberRepo members;
+  private final RoomBookRepo roomBooks;
+  private final UserFeatureService users;
+  private final RoomMemberProgressRepo progress;
+
+  MemoShareService(MemoShareRepository shares, ReadingNoteRepository personal,
+      ReadingRoomNoteRepository roomNotes, RoomRepo rooms, RoomMemberRepo members,
+      RoomBookRepo roomBooks, UserFeatureService users, RoomMemberProgressRepo progress) {
+    this.shares = shares; this.personal = personal; this.roomNotes = roomNotes;
+    this.rooms = rooms; this.members = members; this.roomBooks = roomBooks;
+    this.users = users; this.progress = progress;
+  }
+
+  private AppUser member(String username, Long roomId) {
+    AppUser user = users.me(username);
+    if (!rooms.existsById(roomId))
+      throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "ROOM_NOT_FOUND", "독서방이 없습니다.");
+    if (!members.existsByRoomIdAndUserId(roomId, user.id))
+      throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "ROOM_MEMBER_REQUIRED", "독서방 참여자만 사용할 수 있습니다.");
+    return user;
+  }
+
+  @Transactional
+  MemoShareResponse share(String username, Long targetRoomId, MemoShareRequest request) {
+    AppUser user = member(username, targetRoomId);
+    if (request.memoId() == null || request.memoId() <= 0)
+      throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "INVALID_MEMO_ID", "메모 ID를 확인해 주세요.");
+    MemoShare share = new MemoShare();
+    share.targetRoomId = targetRoomId;
+    share.sharedBy = user.id;
+    Long bookId;
+    if ("PERSONAL".equals(request.sourceType())) {
+      ReadingNote note = personal.findById(request.memoId())
+          .orElseThrow(() -> new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "MEMO_NOT_FOUND", "메모가 없습니다."));
+      if (!note.user.id.equals(user.id))
+        throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "MEMO_OWNER_REQUIRED", "본인 메모만 공유할 수 있습니다.");
+      if (note.noteType != ReadingNoteType.MEMO)
+        throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "MEMO_ONLY", "메모만 공유할 수 있습니다.");
+      if (shares.existsByTargetRoomIdAndPersonalMemoId(targetRoomId, note.id))
+        throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "ALREADY_SHARED", "이미 공유한 메모입니다.");
+      bookId = note.bookId;
+      share.personalMemoId = note.id;
+    } else if ("ROOM".equals(request.sourceType())) {
+      ReadingRoomNote note = roomNotes.findById(request.memoId())
+          .orElseThrow(() -> new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "MEMO_NOT_FOUND", "메모가 없습니다."));
+      if (!note.userId.equals(user.id))
+        throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "MEMO_OWNER_REQUIRED", "본인 메모만 공유할 수 있습니다.");
+      if (!"MEMO".equals(note.type))
+        throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "MEMO_ONLY", "메모만 공유할 수 있습니다.");
+      if (!members.existsByRoomIdAndUserId(note.roomId, user.id))
+        throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "SOURCE_ROOM_MEMBER_REQUIRED", "원본 독서방 참여자여야 합니다.");
+      if (note.roomId.equals(targetRoomId))
+        throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "SAME_ROOM", "이미 원본 메모가 있는 방입니다.");
+      if (shares.existsByTargetRoomIdAndRoomMemoId(targetRoomId, note.id))
+        throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "ALREADY_SHARED", "이미 공유한 메모입니다.");
+      bookId = note.bookId;
+      share.roomMemoId = note.id;
+    } else {
+      throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "INVALID_SOURCE_TYPE", "PERSONAL 또는 ROOM을 선택해 주세요.");
+    }
+    if (!roomBooks.existsByRoomIdAndBookId(targetRoomId, bookId))
+      throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "ROOM_BOOK_MISMATCH", "대상 독서방에 등록된 책이 아닙니다.");
+    shares.saveAndFlush(share);
+    return response(user, targetRoomId, share);
+  }
+
+  @Transactional(readOnly = true)
+  List<MemoShareResponse> list(String username, Long roomId, Long bookId) {
+    AppUser user = member(username, roomId);
+    return shares.findByTargetRoomIdOrderByIdDesc(roomId).stream()
+        .map(share -> response(user, roomId, share))
+        .filter(r -> bookId == null || bookId.equals(r.bookId()))
+        .toList();
+  }
+
+  @Transactional
+  void revoke(String username, Long roomId, Long shareId) {
+    AppUser user = member(username, roomId);
+    MemoShare share = shares.findById(shareId)
+        .filter(s -> s.targetRoomId.equals(roomId))
+        .orElseThrow(() -> new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "SHARE_NOT_FOUND", "공유 기록이 없습니다."));
+    if (!share.sharedBy.equals(user.id))
+      throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "SHARE_OWNER_REQUIRED", "공유한 사람만 취소할 수 있습니다.");
+    shares.delete(share);
+  }
+
+  private MemoShareResponse response(AppUser viewer, Long roomId, MemoShare share) {
+    Long memoId, bookId, authorId;
+    String type, selected, content, color;
+    int paragraphOrder;
+    Integer start, end;
+    if (share.personalMemoId != null) {
+      ReadingNote n = personal.findById(share.personalMemoId).orElseThrow();
+      memoId = n.id; bookId = n.bookId; authorId = n.user.id;
+      type = n.noteType.name(); paragraphOrder = n.paragraphOrder;
+      start = n.startOffset; end = n.endOffset; selected = n.selectedText;
+      content = n.memoContent; color = n.highlightColor;
+    } else {
+      ReadingRoomNote n = roomNotes.findById(share.roomMemoId).orElseThrow();
+      memoId = n.id; bookId = n.bookId; authorId = n.userId;
+      type = n.type; paragraphOrder = n.paragraphOrder;
+      start = n.startOffset; end = n.endOffset; selected = n.selectedText;
+      content = n.content; color = n.highlightColor;
+    }
+    boolean lockEnabled = members.findByRoomIdAndUserId(roomId, viewer.id)
+        .map(m -> m.spoilerLockEnabled).orElse(false);
+    int lastPosition = progress.findByRoomIdAndUserIdAndBookId(roomId, viewer.id, bookId)
+        .map(p -> p.lastReadPosition).orElse(0);
+    boolean locked = lockEnabled && !viewer.id.equals(authorId) && paragraphOrder > lastPosition;
+    return new MemoShareResponse(share.id, share.personalMemoId != null ? "PERSONAL" : "ROOM",
+        memoId, bookId, authorId, type, paragraphOrder,
+        locked ? null : start, locked ? null : end,
+        locked ? null : selected, locked ? null : content, locked ? null : color,
+        locked, viewer.id.equals(authorId), share.sharedAt);
+  }
+}
+
+@RestController
+@RequestMapping("/api/reading-rooms/{roomId}/memo-shares")
+class MemoShareController {
+  private final MemoShareService service;
+  private final ReadingRoomNoteService roomNoteService;
+  MemoShareController(MemoShareService service, ReadingRoomNoteService roomNoteService) {
+    this.service = service; this.roomNoteService = roomNoteService;
+  }
+
+  /** Combined read-only feed. Original note APIs and comment IDs remain untouched. */
+  @GetMapping("/feed")
+  List<MemoFeedItem> feed(@PathVariable Long roomId, @RequestParam(required = false) Long bookId,
+      org.springframework.security.core.Authentication auth) {
+    List<MemoFeedItem> result = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
+    for (RoomNoteResponse note : roomNoteService.list(auth.getName(), roomId, bookId))
+      result.add(new MemoFeedItem("ROOM", note, null));
+    for (MemoShareResponse share : service.list(auth.getName(), roomId, bookId))
+      result.add(new MemoFeedItem("SHARED", null, share));
+    result.sort(java.util.Comparator.comparingInt(item ->
+        item.roomNote() != null ? item.roomNote().paragraphOrder() : item.sharedMemo().paragraphOrder()));
+    return result;
+  }
+
+  @PostMapping
+  @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
+  MemoShareResponse share(@PathVariable Long roomId, @Valid @RequestBody MemoShareRequest request,
+      org.springframework.security.core.Authentication auth) {
+    return service.share(auth.getName(), roomId, request);
+  }
+
+  @GetMapping
+  List<MemoShareResponse> list(@PathVariable Long roomId, @RequestParam(required = false) Long bookId,
+      org.springframework.security.core.Authentication auth) {
+    return service.list(auth.getName(), roomId, bookId);
+  }
+
+  @DeleteMapping("/{shareId}")
+  @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
+  void revoke(@PathVariable Long roomId, @PathVariable Long shareId,
+      org.springframework.security.core.Authentication auth) {
+    service.revoke(auth.getName(), roomId, shareId);
+  }
+}

+import '../core/api_client.dart';
+
+/// 메모 원본의 위치
+/// PERSONAL: 혼자읽기 메모
+/// ROOM: 교환독서방 메모
+enum MemoShareSource {
+  personal,
+  room,
+}
+
+/// 공유된 메모 정보
+class MemoShareRecord {
+  const MemoShareRecord({
+    required this.shareId,
+    required this.sourceType,
+    required this.memoId,
+    required this.bookId,
+    required this.authorId,
+    required this.content,
+    required this.spoilerLocked,
+    required this.mine,
+  });
+
+  final int shareId;
+  final String sourceType;
+  final int memoId;
+  final int bookId;
+  final int authorId;
+  final String? content;
+  final bool spoilerLocked;
+  final bool mine;
+
+  factory MemoShareRecord.fromJson(
+      Map<String, dynamic> json,
+      ) {
+    return MemoShareRecord(
+      shareId: (json['shareId'] as num).toInt(),
+      sourceType: json['sourceType'] as String,
+      memoId: (json['memoId'] as num).toInt(),
+      bookId: (json['bookId'] as num).toInt(),
+      authorId: (json['authorId'] as num).toInt(),
+      content: json['content'] as String?,
+      spoilerLocked: json['spoilerLocked'] == true,
+      mine: json['mine'] == true,
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+/// 메모 공유 API
+class MemoShareRepository {
+  const MemoShareRepository(this._api);
+
+  final ApiClient _api;
+
+  /// 선택한 메모를 대상 독서방에 공유
+  Future<MemoShareRecord> share({
+    required int targetRoomId,
+    required MemoShareSource source,
+    required int memoId,
+  }) async {
+    final response = await _api.post<MemoShareRecord>(
+      '/api/reading-rooms/$targetRoomId/memo-shares',
+      body: {
+        'sourceType':
+        source == MemoShareSource.personal
+            ? 'PERSONAL'
+            : 'ROOM',
+        'memoId': memoId,
+      },
+      parse: (json) => MemoShareRecord.fromJson(
+        json as Map<String, dynamic>,
+      ),
+    );
+
+    return response.data!;
+  }
+
+  /// 해당 독서방에 공유된 메모 목록
+  Future<List<MemoShareRecord>> list({
+    required int roomId,
+    int? bookId,
+  }) async {
+    final response =
+    await _api.get<List<MemoShareRecord>>(
+      '/api/reading-rooms/$roomId/memo-shares',
+      query: {
+        if (bookId != null) 'bookId': '$bookId',
+      },
+      parse: (json) => (json as List<dynamic>)
+          .map(
+            (e) => MemoShareRecord.fromJson(
+          e as Map<String, dynamic>,
+        ),
+      )
+          .toList(),
+    );
+
+    return response.data ?? const [];
+  }
+
+  /// 특정 독서방에서만 공유 취소
+  /// 원본 메모는 삭제하지 않음
+  Future<void> revoke({
+    required int roomId,
+    required int shareId,
+  }) async {
+    await _api.delete<void>(
+      '/api/reading-rooms/$roomId/memo-shares/$shareId',
+    );
+  }
+
+  /// 기존 독서방 메모 + 공유받은 메모 통합 조회
+  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> feed({
+    required int roomId,
+    required int bookId,
+  }) async {
+    final response =
+    await _api.get<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
+      '/api/reading-rooms/$roomId/memo-shares/feed',
+      query: {
+        'bookId': '$bookId',
+      },
+      parse: (json) => (json as List<dynamic>)
+          .map(
+            (e) => e as Map<String, dynamic>,
+      )
+          .toList(),
+    );
+
+    return response.data ?? const [];
+  }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+CREATE TABLE change_book_memo_shares (
+    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
+
+    -- 원본이 개인 메모라면 사용
+    personal_memo_id BIGINT
+        REFERENCES change_book_reading_notes(id)
+        ON DELETE CASCADE,
+
+    -- 원본이 독서방 메모라면 사용
+    room_memo_id BIGINT
+        REFERENCES change_book_reading_room_notes(id)
+        ON DELETE CASCADE,
+
+    -- 공유 대상 독서방
+    target_room_id BIGINT NOT NULL
+        REFERENCES change_book_reading_rooms(id)
+        ON DELETE CASCADE,
+
+    -- 공유한 사용자
+    shared_by BIGINT NOT NULL
+        REFERENCES change_book_users(id)
+        ON DELETE CASCADE,
+
+    shared_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
+        DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
+
+    -- 원본 메모는 반드시 둘 중 하나
+    CONSTRAINT chk_change_book_memo_share_source
+        CHECK (
+            (personal_memo_id IS NOT NULL AND room_memo_id IS NULL)
+            OR
+            (personal_memo_id IS NULL AND room_memo_id IS NOT NULL)
+        )
+);
+
+-- 같은 개인 메모를 같은 방에 중복 공유 방지
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_change_book_personal_memo_share
+    ON change_book_memo_shares (
+        personal_memo_id,
+        target_room_id
+    )
+    WHERE personal_memo_id IS NOT NULL;
+
+-- 같은 방 메모를 같은 방에 중복 공유 방지
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_change_book_room_memo_share
+    ON change_book_memo_shares (
+        room_memo_id,
+        target_room_id
+    )
+    WHERE room_memo_id IS NOT NULL;
+
+-- 독서방별 공유 메모 조회
+CREATE INDEX idx_change_book_memo_shares_target_room
+    ON change_book_memo_shares (target_room_id);

 class _SelectableParagraphSliceState extends State<_SelectableParagraphSlice> {
+  final GlobalKey _selectableTextKey = GlobalKey();
+  final GlobalKey _textStackKey = GlobalKey();
+  List<Offset> _memoIconPositions = const [];
+
+  // 실제 화면의 SelectableText가 사용하는 RenderEditable에서 위치를 얻는다.
+  void _updateMemoIconPositions(List<int> ends, int textLength) {
+    if (!mounted) return;
+    final textContext = _selectableTextKey.currentContext;
+    final stackContext = _textStackKey.currentContext;
+    if (textContext == null || stackContext == null) return;
+    final stackBox = stackContext.findRenderObject();
+    if (stackBox is! RenderBox || !stackBox.hasSize) return;
+
+    RenderEditable? editable;
+    void visit(Element element) {
+      if (editable != null) return;
+      if (element is RenderObjectElement &&
+          element.renderObject is RenderEditable) {
+        editable = element.renderObject as RenderEditable;
+        return;
+      }
+      element.visitChildren(visit);
+    }
+    (textContext as Element).visitChildren(visit);
+    final renderEditable = editable;
+    if (renderEditable == null || !renderEditable.hasSize) return;
+
+    final next = <Offset>[];
+    for (final end in ends) {
+      if (end <= 0 || end > textLength) continue;
+      final boxes = renderEditable.getBoxesForSelection(
+        TextSelection(baseOffset: end - 1, extentOffset: end),
+      );
+      if (boxes.isEmpty) continue;
+      final last = boxes.last;
+      final global = renderEditable.localToGlobal(Offset(last.right, last.bottom));
+      final local = stackBox.globalToLocal(global);
+      next.add(Offset(local.dx + 1, local.dy - 2));
+    }
+    if (next.length == _memoIconPositions.length &&
+        List.generate(next.length, (i) => next[i] == _memoIconPositions[i])
+            .every((same) => same)) return;
+    setState(() => _memoIconPositions = next);
+  }

+  const _SortMenuButton();

+  @override
+  State<_SortMenuButton> createState() => _SortMenuButtonState();

+class _SortMenuButtonState extends State<_SortMenuButton> {
+  final LayerLink _layerLink = LayerLink();
+  OverlayEntry? _overlayEntry;
+
+  void _closeMenu() {
+    _overlayEntry?.remove();
+    _overlayEntry?.dispose();
+    _overlayEntry = null;
+  }
+
+  void _toggleMenu() {
+    if (_overlayEntry != null) {
+      _closeMenu();
+      return;
+    }
+
+    _overlayEntry = OverlayEntry(
+      builder: (context) => Stack(
+        children: [
+          Positioned.fill(
+            child: GestureDetector(
+              behavior: HitTestBehavior.translucent,
+              onTap: _closeMenu,
+            ),
+          ),
+          CompositedTransformFollower(
+            link: _layerLink,
+            showWhenUnlinked: false,
+            targetAnchor: Alignment.bottomRight,
+            followerAnchor: Alignment.topRight,
+            offset: const Offset(0, 4),
+            child: Material(
+              color: Colors.white,
+              elevation: 3,
+              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
+              child: SizedBox(
+                width: 80,
+                child: Column(
+                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
+                  children: [
+                    _sortItem('최신순'),
+                    _sortItem('이름순'),
+                  ],
+                ),
+              ),
+            ),
+          ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+
+    Overlay.of(context).insert(_overlayEntry!);
+  }
+
+  Widget _sortItem(String label) {
+    return InkWell(
+      onTap: _closeMenu,
+      child: SizedBox(
+        height: 44,
+        child: Center(
+          child: Text(
+            label,
+            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+
+  @override
+  void dispose() {
+    _closeMenu();
+    super.dispose();
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    return Padding(
+      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 20),
+      child: CompositedTransformTarget(
+        link: _layerLink,
+        child: InkWell(
+          onTap: _toggleMenu,
+          child: const Padding(
+            padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
+            child: Row(
+              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
+              children: [
+                Icon(Icons.swap_vert, size: 17),
+                SizedBox(width: 6),
+                Text(
+                  '최신순',
+                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
+                ),
+                SizedBox(width: 4),
+                Icon(Icons.keyboard_arrow_down, size: 18),
+              ],
+            ),
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+  }

+@PostMapping("/ai-reading-friends")
+@ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
+@org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
+AiReadingFriendResponse createFriend(
+        @Valid @RequestBody CreateAiReadingFriendRequest request,
+        org.springframework.security.core.Authentication authentication
+) {
+    var user = currentUser(authentication);
+
+    // 1. 사용자 입력으로 프롬프트 생성
+    String prompt = characterPromptService.makeCharacterPrompt(
+            request.name(),
+            request.age(),
+            request.gender(),
+            request.relationship(),
+            request.personality(),
+            request.speechStyle(),
+            request.traits()
+    );
+
+    // 2. Gemini로 AI 페르소나 생성
+    String generatedPersona = geminiClient.generate(prompt);
+
+    if (generatedPersona == null || generatedPersona.isBlank()) {
+        throw new ApiException(
+                HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
+                "PERSONA_GENERATION_FAILED",
+                "AI 독서친구 페르소나 생성에 실패했습니다."
+        );
     }
 
+    // 3. AI 독서친구 생성
+    AiReadingFriend friend = new AiReadingFriend();
+
+    friend.userId = user.id;
+    friend.name = request.name().trim();
+    friend.isDefault = false;
+
+    // 4. 사용자 입력 원본 저장
+    friend.inputAge = emptyToNull(request.age());
+    friend.inputGender = emptyToNull(request.gender());
+    friend.inputRelationship = emptyToNull(request.relationship());
+    friend.inputPersonality = emptyToNull(request.personality());
+    friend.inputSpeechStyle = emptyToNull(request.speechStyle());
+    friend.inputTraits = emptyToNull(request.traits());
+
+    // 5. AI 생성 페르소나 저장
+    friend.persona = generatedPersona.trim();
+
+    friend.createdAt = java.time.OffsetDateTime.now();
+    friend.updatedAt = friend.createdAt;
+
+    // 6. DB에 저장
+    return AiReadingFriendResponse.from(
+            friendRepository.save(friend)
+    );
+}

+@Service
+public class CharacterPromptService {

+    public String makeCharacterPrompt(
+            String name,
+            String age,
+            String gender,
+            String relationship,
+            String personality,
+            String speechStyle,
+            String traits
+    ) {
+        return """
+                너는 AI 독서친구의 캐릭터 프로필을 작성하는 역할이다.
+
+                사용자가 입력한 기본 설정을 바탕으로
+                실제로 책을 함께 읽는 사람처럼 느껴지는
+                구체적이고 자연스러운 캐릭터 프로필을 작성한다.
+
+                이 프로필은 단순한 캐릭터 소개가 아니라,
+                AI가 실제로 책을 읽고 여백에 메모를 남길 때
+                인물의 성격, 경험, 말투, 사고방식을 일관되게
+                유지하기 위한 페르소나이다.
+
+                [사용자 입력]
+
+                이름: %s
+                나이: %s
+                성별: %s
+                사용자와의 관계: %s
+                성격: %s
+                말투: %s
+                특징: %s
+
+                # 전체 작성 규칙
+
+                사용자가 제공한 정보를 임의로 변경하지 않는다.
+
+                사용자가 입력한 성격, 관계, 말투, 특징을
+                자연스러운 행동과 사고방식으로 구체화한다.
+
+                예를 들어 "차분하고 생각이 많다"라는 설정은
+                "무언가를 바로 좋다거나 싫다고 판단하기보다
+                왜 그런지 한 번 더 생각해보는 편이다"처럼
+                자연스럽게 확장할 수 있다.
+
+                단순히 입력된 형용사를 반복하지 않는다.
+
+                실제 사람처럼 성격에 여러 면이 존재하도록 작성한다.
+                장점뿐 아니라 자연스러운 약점이나 한계도
+                필요하다면 포함한다.
+
+                캐릭터를 지나치게 극단적으로 만들지 않는다.
+
+                사용자가 제공하지 않은 중요한 사실을
+                임의로 만들어내지 않는다.
+
+                특히 다음 정보는 근거 없이 추가하지 않는다.
+                - 가족관계
+                - 특정 직업
+                - 특정 사건이나 트라우마
+                - 연애 경험
+                - 특정 지역
+                - 특정 학교
+                - 사용자와 실제로 있었던 경험
+
+                입력되지 않은 정보는 억지로 채우지 않는다.
+
+                사용자가 제공한 정보에서 자연스럽게
+                추론할 수 있는 범위에서만 구체화한다.
+
+                사용자에 대한 정보가 주어지지 않았다면
+                사용자의 취향, 경험, 성격, 과거를 지어내지 않는다.
+
+                캐릭터의 나이, 관계, 생활환경에 어울리는
+                자연스러운 표현을 사용한다.
+
+                # 반드시 다음 4가지 Markdown 항목으로 작성한다.
+
+                # 캐릭터 %s
+
+                ## 기본 프로필
+
+                나이, 성별, 현재 상황, 사용자와의 관계를
+                자연스러운 문장으로 작성한다.
+
+                사용자와의 관계는 단순히 관계의 이름만
+                설명하지 않고 두 사람 사이의 거리감과
+                친밀도가 느껴지도록 작성한다.
+
+                사용자가 제공한 관계 설정을 바탕으로
+                서로 얼마나 편하게 이야기하는 사이인지,
+                어떤 태도로 사용자를 대하는지 설명한다.
+
+                친한 사이라면 가끔 사용자에게 직접
+                말을 걸듯 이야기할 수 있다.
+
+                하지만 항상 사용자를 향해 말하지는 않는다.
+                대부분은 자기 생각을 자연스럽게 말한다.
+
+                아주 오래 알고 지낸 관계가 아니라면
+                사용자의 모든 취향이나 과거를
+                알고 있는 것처럼 행동하지 않는다.
+
+                사용자의 정보가 없다면
+                취향, 경험, 성격을 임의로 만들어내지 않는다.
+
+                ## 성격
+
+                사용자가 입력한 성격을 중심으로 작성한다.
+
+                형용사를 단순히 나열하지 않고
+                실제 행동과 사고방식으로 표현한다.
+
+                어떤 상황에서 쉽게 흥미를 느끼는지,
+                무엇에 민감하게 반응하는지,
+                다른 사람이나 사건을 어떻게 받아들이는지
+                자연스럽게 구체화한다.
+
+                성격의 장점뿐 아니라 자연스러운
+                약점이나 한계도 필요하다면 포함한다.
+
+                항상 같은 감정이나 태도를 보이는
+                단조로운 캐릭터로 만들지 않는다.
+
+                평소 장난기가 많은 인물도
+                진지한 상황에서는 진지하게 반응할 수 있다.
+
+                차분한 인물도 상황에 따라
+                놀라거나 당황하거나 감정적으로 반응할 수 있다.
+
+                사용자가 설정하지 않은 성격을
+                지나치게 강조하거나 극단적으로 만들지 않는다.
+
+                ## 생활과 경험
+
+                사용자가 제공한 나이, 현재 상황,
+                성격, 특징을 바탕으로 작성한다.
+
+                캐릭터가 실제로 겪었을 법한
+                일상적인 생활과 경험을 설명한다.
+
+                사용자가 직업이나 학교생활 등을
+                명시했다면 그 설정을 반영한다.
+
+                명시하지 않았다면 특정 직업이나 학교,
+                구체적인 과거 사건을 임의로 확정하지 않는다.
+
+                사용자가 제공한 관심사나 특징이 있다면
+                일상생활과 사고방식에 자연스럽게 반영한다.
+
+                예를 들어 인터넷을 자주 사용하는 인물이라면
+                온라인 문화에 익숙한 모습이 나타날 수 있다.
+
+                하지만 사용자가 설정하지 않았다면
+                특정 SNS나 인터넷 문화를
+                반드시 사용하는 인물로 만들지 않는다.
+
+                캐릭터의 경험은 책을 읽다가
+                자연스럽게 떠오를 수 있는 배경이 된다.
+
+                다만 책의 모든 장면을 자신의 경험과
+                억지로 연결하도록 설정하지 않는다.
+
+                실제로 경험하지 않았을 법한 일을
+                겪은 것처럼 만들어내지 않는다.
+
+                ## 말하는 방식
+
+                사용자가 입력한 말투와 성격,
+                사용자와의 관계를 바탕으로 작성한다.
+
+                문장 길이, 표현 방식, 질문하는 방식,
+                감정을 드러내는 방식 등을 구체화한다.
+
+                특정 종결 표현을 반복하는 방식으로
+                말투를 정의하지 않는다.
+
+                캐릭터가 실제로 책을 읽다가
+                여백에 메모를 남기는 것처럼 반응하도록 설정한다.
+
+                생각을 완성된 감상문처럼 정리하지 않는다.
+                읽는 순간 머릿속에 실제로 떠오른
+                형태에 가깝게 적는다.
+
+                짧은 질문, 혼잣말, 감탄, 당황,
+                농담, 책 속 인물이나 대상에게 하는 말,
+                자기 경험에서 순간적으로 떠오른 생각 등이
+                자연스럽게 나올 수 있다.
+
+                다만 모든 종류의 반응을
+                반드시 사용해야 하는 것은 아니다.
+
+                첫 반응만으로 충분하다면
+                거기서 끝낼 수 있다.
+
+                왜 그렇게 느꼈는지
+                뒤에서 다시 설명하지 않는다.
+
+                본문에 나온 인물 이름, 설정, 사건 등을
+                단순히 확인하거나 요약하기 위한 말을 하지 않는다.
+
+                새로운 정보를 알게 되었다는 이유만으로
+                "○○구나", "○○였네"처럼
+                본문 내용을 그대로 되풀이하지 않는다.
+
+                "표현 웃기다", "묘사가 재밌다",
+                "과몰입하게 되네"처럼
+                자신의 반응을 다시 해설하거나
+                평가하는 표현을 습관적으로 사용하지 않는다.
+
+                모든 문장을 분석하거나
+                의미를 찾아내려고 하지 않는다.
+
+                특정 장면을 반드시 찾아내거나
+                모든 장면에 반응하도록 설정하지 않는다.
+
+                생각이 들지 않는 부분은
+                자연스럽게 지나갈 수 있어야 한다.
+
+                문장이 반드시 완전한 형태일 필요는 없다.
+
+                사용자와의 관계에 맞는
+                자연스러운 거리감으로 말한다.
+
+                캐릭터의 나이와 생활환경에 맞는
+                일상적인 표현이 자연스럽게 나타날 수 있다.
+
+                인터넷 표현, 유행어, 밈, 줄임말,
+                감탄사, 웃음 표현, 거친 표현 등은
+                캐릭터에게 자연스러운 경우에만 사용한다.
+
+                특정 말투를 보여주기 위해
+                유행어나 인터넷 표현을 억지로 넣지 않는다.
+
+                외모, 신체, 성별 등을 낮춰 부르는
+                비하적 표현을 재미있는 표현처럼
+                소비하거나 웃음거리로 삼지 않는다.
+
+                아직 읽지 않은 책의 뒷내용을
+                알고 있는 것처럼 행동하지 않는다.
+
+                책에서 실제로 읽은 내용과
+                자신의 추측이나 상상을 구분한다.
+
+                # 출력 규칙
+
+                완성된 Markdown 페르소나 문서만 출력한다.
+
+                반드시 다음 4개 항목만 사용한다.
+                1. 기본 프로필
+                2. 성격
+                3. 생활과 경험
+                4. 말하는 방식
+
+                다른 항목을 추가하지 않는다.
+                항목을 생략하거나 이름을 변경하지 않는다.
+
+                각 항목은 실제 캐릭터 설정 문서처럼
+                자연스러운 서술형 문장으로 작성한다.
+
+                "사용자가 입력한 성격을 반영한다"처럼
+                AI에게 지시하는 문장이 아니라
+                "반응이 빠르고 장난기가 있다"처럼
+                캐릭터 자체를 설명하는 문장으로 작성한다.
+
+                사용자가 입력하지 않은 정보를
+                "정보 없음"이라고 반복해서 출력하지 않는다.
+
+                추가 설명을 붙이지 않는다.
+                Markdown 코드블록으로 감싸지 않는다.
+                """.formatted(
+                value(name),
+                value(age),
+                value(gender),
+                value(relationship),
+                value(personality),
+                value(speechStyle),
+                value(traits),
+                value(name)
+        );
+    }
+
+    private String value(String input) {
+        return input == null || input.isBlank()
+                ? "정보 없음"
+                : input.trim();
+    }
+}

+    // =========================================================
+// AI 친구의 독서 진행률 조회
+// =========================================================
+
+@GetMapping("/books/{bookId}/ai-reading-friends/{friendId}/progress")
+Map<String, Object> getReadingProgress(
+        @PathVariable Long bookId,
+        @PathVariable Long friendId,
+        org.springframework.security.core.Authentication authentication
+) {
+    var user = currentUser(authentication);
+    requireAccessibleFriend(friendId, authentication);
+
+    var paragraphs =
+            paragraphRepository.findByBookIdOrderByParagraphOrderAsc(bookId);
+
+    var progress = progressRepository
+            .findByUserIdAndFriendIdAndBookId(
+                    user.id,
+                    friendId,
+                    bookId
+            );
+
+    int total = paragraphs.size();
+
+    int processed = progress.map(p ->
+            (int) paragraphs.stream()
+                    .filter(paragraph ->
+                            paragraph.paragraphOrder <= p.lastParagraphOrder)
+                    .count()
+    ).orElse(0);
+
+    boolean completed = progress
+            .map(p -> p.completed)
+            .orElse(false);
+
+    int percent = completed
+            ? 100
+            : total == 0
+                    ? 0
+                    : Math.min(99, processed * 100 / total);
+
+    return Map.of(
+            "friendId", friendId,
+            "bookId", bookId,
+            "percent", percent,
+            "completed", completed
+    );
+}

     // =========================================================

+// AI 친구별 실제 진행률 가져오기
+  Future<void> _refreshAiProgress() async {
+    if (!mounted || _generatingAiFriendIds.isEmpty ||
+        _aiProgressRefreshBusy) return;
+    _aiProgressRefreshBusy = true;
+    try {
+      final token = context.read<RidiStore>().accessToken;
+      final repository = AiReadingRepository(
+        ApiClient(tokenProvider: () => token),
+      );
+      for (final friendId in _generatingAiFriendIds.toList()) {
+        try {
+          final result = await repository.getReadingProgress(
+            bookId: widget.bookId,
+            friendId: friendId,
+          );
+          if (!mounted) return;
+          final percent = (result['percent'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
+          _aiProgressPercent[friendId] = percent.clamp(0, 100).toInt();
+          _notifyAiProgress();
+        } catch (e) {
+          debugPrint('AI 친구 진행률 조회 실패: $e');
+        }
+      }
+    } finally {
+      _aiProgressRefreshBusy = false;
+    }
+  }
+
+  void _startAiProgressPolling() {
+    _aiProgressTimer?.cancel();
+    unawaited(_refreshAiProgress());
+    _aiProgressTimer = Timer.periodic(
+      const Duration(seconds: 2),
+          (_) => unawaited(_refreshAiProgress()),
+    );
+  }
+
+  // 메모 생성은 보기 설정 팝업과 독립적으로 실행한다.
+  Future<void> _generateAiNotesInReader(
+      AiReadingRepository repository,
+      Set<int> selectedIds,
+      ) async {
+    for (final friendId in selectedIds) {
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      _generatingAiFriendIds.add(friendId);
+      _aiFailedFriendIds.remove(friendId);
+      _aiProgressPercent[friendId] = 0;
+      _notifyAiProgress();
+      _startAiProgressPolling();
+      try {
+        final notes = await repository.generateNotes(
+          bookId: widget.bookId,
+          friendId: friendId,
+        );
+        if (!mounted) return;
+        // generateNotes는 파싱 실패 시 정상 반환할 수 있으므로 완료 상태를 검증한다.
+        final progress = await repository.getReadingProgress(
+          bookId: widget.bookId,
+          friendId: friendId,
+        );
+        if (!mounted) return;
+        final completed = progress['completed'] == true;
+        final percent = (progress['percent'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
+        setState(() {
+          _aiNotesByFriend[friendId] = notes;
+          _aiProgressPercent[friendId] = completed
+              ? 100 : percent.clamp(0, 99).toInt();
+        });
+        if (completed) {
+          _aiMessage('${_friendName(friendId)}가 AI 메모 작성을 완료했어요.');
+        } else {
+          _aiFailedFriendIds.add(friendId);
+          _aiMessage('${_friendName(friendId)}의 AI 메모 작성이 중간에 멈췄어요. 다시 시도해 주세요.');
+        }
+      } catch (e) {
+        if (!mounted) return;
+        _aiFailedFriendIds.add(friendId);
+        _aiMessage('${_friendName(friendId)}의 AI 메모 작성 중 오류가 발생했어요.');
+        debugPrint('AI 메모 생성 실패 (friendId=$friendId): $e');
+        // 오류가 나도 다른 친구의 작업은 이어서 시도한다.
+      } finally {
+        _generatingAiFriendIds.remove(friendId);
+        if (_generatingAiFriendIds.isEmpty) {
+          _aiProgressTimer?.cancel();
+          _aiProgressTimer = null;
+        }
+        _notifyAiProgress();
+      }
+    }
+  }

+    // =========================================================
+// AI 친구의 독서 진행률 조회
+// =========================================================
+
+@GetMapping("/books/{bookId}/ai-reading-friends/{friendId}/progress")
+Map<String, Object> getReadingProgress(
+        @PathVariable Long bookId,
+        @PathVariable Long friendId,
+        org.springframework.security.core.Authentication authentication
+) {
+    var user = currentUser(authentication);
+    requireAccessibleFriend(friendId, authentication);
+
+    var paragraphs =
+            paragraphRepository.findByBookIdOrderByParagraphOrderAsc(bookId);
+
+    var progress = progressRepository
+            .findByUserIdAndFriendIdAndBookId(
+                    user.id,
+                    friendId,
+                    bookId
+            );
+
+    int total = paragraphs.size();
+
+    int processed = progress.map(p ->
+            (int) paragraphs.stream()
+                    .filter(paragraph ->
+                            paragraph.paragraphOrder <= p.lastParagraphOrder)
+                    .count()
+    ).orElse(0);
+
+    boolean completed = progress
+            .map(p -> p.completed)
+            .orElse(false);
+
+    int percent = completed
+            ? 100
+            : total == 0
+                    ? 0
+                    : Math.min(99, processed * 100 / total);
+
+    return Map.of(
+            "friendId", friendId,
+            "bookId", bookId,
+            "percent", percent,
+            "completed", completed
+    );
+}

+  Future<void> _refreshAiProgress() async {

+        _aiProgressRefreshBusy) return;
+    _aiProgressRefreshBusy = true;

+      final repository = AiReadingRepository(
+        ApiClient(tokenProvider: () => token),
+      );
+      for (final friendId in _generatingAiFriendIds.toList()) {

+          final result = await repository.getReadingProgress(

+            friendId: friendId,
+          );

+          final percent = (result['percent'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
+          _aiProgressPercent[friendId] = percent.clamp(0, 100).toInt();
+          _notifyAiProgress();

+          debugPrint('AI 친구 진행률 조회 실패: $e');
+        }
+      }
+    } finally {

+    }
+  }

+    _aiProgressTimer = Timer.periodic(

+    // =========================================================
+// AI 친구의 독서 진행률 조회
+// =========================================================
+
+@GetMapping("/books/{bookId}/ai-reading-friends/{friendId}/progress")
+Map<String, Object> getReadingProgress(
+        @PathVariable Long bookId,
+        @PathVariable Long friendId,
+        org.springframework.security.core.Authentication authentication
+) {
+    var user = currentUser(authentication);
+    requireAccessibleFriend(friendId, authentication);
+
+    var paragraphs =
+            paragraphRepository.findByBookIdOrderByParagraphOrderAsc(bookId);
+
+    var progress = progressRepository
+            .findByUserIdAndFriendIdAndBookId(
+                    user.id,
+                    friendId,
+                    bookId
+            );
+
+    int total = paragraphs.size();
+
+    int processed = progress.map(p ->
+            (int) paragraphs.stream()
+                    .filter(paragraph ->
+                            paragraph.paragraphOrder <= p.lastParagraphOrder)
+                    .count()
+    ).orElse(0);
+
+    boolean completed = progress
+            .map(p -> p.completed)
+            .orElse(false);
+
+    int percent = completed
+            ? 100
+            : total == 0
+                    ? 0
+                    : Math.min(99, processed * 100 / total);
+
+    return Map.of(
+            "friendId", friendId,
+            "bookId", bookId,
+            "percent", percent,
+            "completed", completed
+    );
+}

+  Future<void> _refreshAiProgress() async {
+    if (!mounted || _generatingAiFriendIds.isEmpty ||
+        _aiProgressRefreshBusy) return;
+    _aiProgressRefreshBusy = true;
+    try {
+      final token = context.read<RidiStore>().accessToken;
+      final repository = AiReadingRepository(
+        ApiClient(tokenProvider: () => token),
+      );
+      for (final friendId in _generatingAiFriendIds.toList()) {
+        try {
+          final result = await repository.getReadingProgress(
+            bookId: widget.bookId,
+            friendId: friendId,
+          );
+          if (!mounted) return;
+          final percent = (result['percent'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
+          _aiProgressPercent[friendId] = percent.clamp(0, 100).toInt();
+          _notifyAiProgress();
+        } catch (e) {
+          debugPrint('AI 친구 진행률 조회 실패: $e');
+        }
+      }
+    } finally {
+      _aiProgressRefreshBusy = false;
+    }
+  }
+
+  void _startAiProgressPolling() {
+    _aiProgressTimer?.cancel();
+    unawaited(_refreshAiProgress());
+    _aiProgressTimer = Timer.periodic(
+      const Duration(seconds: 2),
+          (_) => unawaited(_refreshAiProgress()),
+    );
+  }

+  // 메모 생성은 보기 설정 팝업과 독립적으로 실행한다.
+  Future<void> _generateAiNotesInReader(
+      AiReadingRepository repository,
+      Set<int> selectedIds,
+      ) async {
+    for (final friendId in selectedIds) {
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      _generatingAiFriendIds.add(friendId);
+      _aiFailedFriendIds.remove(friendId);
+      _aiProgressPercent[friendId] = 0;
+      _notifyAiProgress();
+      _startAiProgressPolling();
+      try {
+        final notes = await repository.generateNotes(
+          bookId: widget.bookId,
+          friendId: friendId,
+        );
+        if (!mounted) return;
+        // generateNotes는 파싱 실패 시 정상 반환할 수 있으므로 완료 상태를 검증한다.
+        final progress = await repository.getReadingProgress(
+          bookId: widget.bookId,
+          friendId: friendId,
+        );
+        if (!mounted) return;
+        final completed = progress['completed'] == true;
+        final percent = (progress['percent'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
+        setState(() {
+          _aiNotesByFriend[friendId] = notes;
+          _aiProgressPercent[friendId] = completed
+              ? 100 : percent.clamp(0, 99).toInt();
+        });
+        if (completed) {
+          _aiMessage('${_friendName(friendId)}가 AI 메모 작성을 완료했어요.');
+        } else {
+          _aiFailedFriendIds.add(friendId);
+          _aiMessage('${_friendName(friendId)}의 AI 메모 작성이 중간에 멈췄어요. 다시 시도해 주세요.');
+        }
+      } catch (e) {
+        if (!mounted) return;
+        _aiFailedFriendIds.add(friendId);
+        _aiMessage('${_friendName(friendId)}의 AI 메모 작성 중 오류가 발생했어요.');

+        // 오류가 나도 다른 친구의 작업은 이어서 시도한다.
+      } finally {
+        _generatingAiFriendIds.remove(friendId);
+        if (_generatingAiFriendIds.isEmpty) {
+          _aiProgressTimer?.cancel();
+          _aiProgressTimer = null;
+        }
+        _notifyAiProgress();
+      }
+    }

@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+-- Keep the caller's selected-book order stable for shelf covers and detail.
+-- Existing links are preserved and receive a deterministic legacy order.
+ALTER TABLE change_book_shelf_books
+    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS display_order INTEGER;
+
+WITH ordered AS (
+    SELECT shelf_id,
+           book_id,
+           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
+               PARTITION BY shelf_id
+               ORDER BY created_at ASC, book_id ASC
+           ) - 1 AS sequence
+    FROM change_book_shelf_books
+    WHERE display_order IS NULL
+)
+UPDATE change_book_shelf_books link
+SET display_order = ordered.sequence
+FROM ordered
+WHERE link.shelf_id = ordered.shelf_id
+  AND link.book_id = ordered.book_id;
+
+ALTER TABLE change_book_shelf_books
+    ALTER COLUMN display_order SET NOT NULL;
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_change_book_shelf_books_display_order
+    ON change_book_shelf_books (shelf_id, display_order);
+
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_change_book_shelf_books_shelf_display_order
+    ON change_book_shelf_books (shelf_id, display_order);
